title: Microsoft presents: BC-Bench: Can coding agents solve real-world AL tasks?

chapters.title: Evaluating coding agents for AL tasks
Dataset creation, quality verification, and diversity
Complexity analysis and code review agent introduction
Code review agent evaluation and online monitoring
Q&A: Source code, data collection, costs, and GitHub models

features.name: BC-Bench benchmarking framework
features.description: An offline evaluation framework for Business Central that evaluates coding agents on various engineering tasks including bug fixing, AL test generation, and code review. Adapted from SWE-bench methodology specifically for the BC and AL ecosystem.
caveats: Currently expanding with new task categories
Results depend on model and agent harness used
Dataset is mix of ADO and GitHub bugs
Will be refreshed with BC apps issues

features.name: Bug fixing agent evaluation
features.description: Evaluation of coding agents on bug fixing tasks using BC-Bench. Agents receive bug reports and code bases, generate fixes, and fixes are verified against unit tests originally created by human engineers.
caveats: Verification depends on existing unit tests
Results show 68% accuracy for latest models versus 16% for GPT-4
Requires manual verification of bug reports
Code must build in Docker environment
Tests must pass after fix and fail before fix

features.name: AL test generation evaluation
features.description: BC-Bench evaluates how well coding agents generate AL tests that match the semantics used in day-to-day development.

features.name: Code review agent evaluation
features.description: BC-Bench is evaluating whether coding agents can perform proper code reviews on AL-related pull requests. The review agent achieves 57% accuracy on comments and 49% accuracy on severity classification.
caveats: Currently in development within BC-Bench expansion
57% accuracy on review comments
49% accuracy on severity classification
Currently visible on BC apps GitHub pull requests
Severity classification has lower accuracy than comment matching

features.name: Natural language to code generation
features.description: BC-Bench is used to evaluate how well coding agents can generate code from natural language descriptions.
caveats: Demonstrated in lab session

features.name: Docker environment setup for BC-Bench
features.description: BC-Bench spins up Docker environments of Business Central using BC Container Helper to allow coding agents to interact with a live Business Central instance.

features.name: Multiple agent harness support
features.description: BC-Bench supports evaluation across different agent harnesses including Cloud Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and others to understand how agent harness selection impacts coding quality.
caveats: Impact varies based on specific tool and task

features.name: Model comparison capability
features.description: BC-Bench allows configuration to compare different language models including GPT models, Claude Opus, and Microsoft frontier models on the same tasks.
caveats: Model availability and release timing affect comparisons

features.name: LLM as judge evaluation
features.description: BC-Bench includes LLM-as-judge capability to evaluate generated code quality when automated verification is not possible.

features.name: GitHub integration and public repository
features.description: BC-Bench source code, experimental transcripts, and artifacts are publicly available on GitHub to enable transparency and reproducibility.

features.name: AL-MCP for coding agents
features.description: An MCP server that provides coding agents with compile capability and symbol search functionality, improving consistency and verification abilities.
caveats: 5% mean resolution rate improvement
10% pass@5 improvement

features.name: Multi-run metrics for coding agents
features.description: A testing methodology using multiple independent runs to capture non-deterministic AI behavior, tracking mean accuracy, pass@5 for consistency, and pass@1 for best-case scenarios.
caveats: AI is non-deterministic
Different metrics can yield very different numbers

features.name: Dataset for bug fixing benchmark
features.description: A curated dataset from Microsoft internal pull requests and BC apps public repository covering diverse areas including inventory (20%) and finance (19%), filtered for single-bug fixes with unit tests.
caveats: Requires manual verification for sufficient context
Manual filtering to ensure test pass after fix and fail before

features.name: Coding agent complexity analysis
features.description: Analysis showing that coding agents achieve 80% accuracy on bugs requiring less than 10 lines of code, but accuracy drops to 50% for more complex fixes.
caveats: Agents struggle with complex scenarios
Significant performance drop above 10 lines of code threshold

features.name: Online evaluation of AI features
features.description: Production monitoring of AI features by tracking user interactions such as thumbs up, heart reactions, thumbs down, and application of suggested fixes.
features.status_evidence_quote: We also do online evaluation. That's also uh something we will or are doing for all um AI features that we ship.
caveats: Monitoring production developer interactions

features.name: Self-Improving Code Review Agent Pipeline
features.description: A pipeline that identifies problematic cases in the code review agent, generates agent-driven fixes to the agent skills, runs evaluations, and automatically ships new versions if quality gates pass. Includes human PI review.
caveats: includes PI review step
requires offline eval quality gates to pass

features.name: BC-Bench Dataset Expansion
features.description: The BC-Bench dataset currently contains ADO and GitHub bugs. Plans to refresh it with more bug-fixing tasks from BC apps as code accumulates. The full dataset will be open source.
caveats: depends on accumulation of BC apps code

features.name: Prompt Compression Experiments
features.description: Experiments using Caveman to compress prompt output or coding agent output to test effects on bug-fixing capabilities. Initial results showed no negative impact, suggesting potential cost savings.
caveats: specific to compression technique Caveman
impact may vary by scenario

features.name: Partner Dataset Leaderboard
features.description: Plans to support partner datasets on the leaderboard to display benchmark numbers from private codebases, providing more diverse results beyond Microsoft public code.
caveats: still under consideration
requires partner participation

features.name: Payables and Sales Agents Code Availability
features.description: Payables engine and sales agent code are currently locked but Microsoft is moving more things to GitHub. These agents are expected to be available soon.
features.status_evidence_quote: Yes, so we're moving more and more things on on GitHub. So, I think these will be available soon
caveats: payables and sales agents currently locked
timeline not specified
